title: Chick-fil-A Rejects AI Drive-Thru Orders for Human Staff
summary:
Automated order-taking technology will not be used in any drive-thru lanes at Chick-fil-A, as the company has decided to maintain the use of human employees for all customer transactions. The fast-food chain announced it will never deploy artificial intelligence to handle drive-thru orders, opting instead for personnel to manage the process, per reports from Fox Business.

The decision is based on the company's commitment to "human to human" hospitality. By rejecting the shift toward automated systems in its lanes, the chain intends to prioritize personal interaction as a central component of its service model.
